conflict_resolutions.PARTIAL_OR_QUALIFIED_CHANGE_REQUIRES_CLA: The qualified section 2 revocation applies to orders insofar as they interpret or amend EO 9. EO 5666 has one operative paragraph, wholly an amendment of EO 9, so the qualification leaves no separate continuing command in EO 5666.

notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: The official GPO printing of EO 5666, printed pages 953-954, was visually checked: its sole operative paragraph amends EO 9 to permit specified Department of Commerce appointments. The hash-matched official 33 FR 6459 PDF page was visually checked: EO 11408 section 2 revokes all prior orders insofar as they interpret or amend EO 9 and expressly lists EO 5666; the signed page reads April 25, 1968 (OCR misreads the day). Earlier known EO 9845, 10044, 10055 and 10645 further amend EO 9 without themselves extinguishing this sole clause; the supposed EO 9800 termination is neighboring EO 9801 text and is rejected. No explicit savings in these two orders preserves an independent command of EO 5666. This establishes provisional NO by the 2026-10-14 cutoff. The exact first cessation date and any accrued consequences of past appointments remain open for a separate lifecycle claim; no complete lifecycle or human certification is asserted.
